verdict.rationale: Kong's docs and repo mention flexible deployment models (DB-less, Docker-based local instances, Konnect free trial, control-plane/data-plane separation) that could be used to spin up an isolated test instance separate from production, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'sandbox environment' or test-mode for AI-native workflows that guarantees production data isolation. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment feature, documentation on isolating AI/agent test traffic from production data, independent confirmation of safe test usage.
